_meta.definition: The process of managing customer, employee, and shipper details and information.

customers._description: Captures details of individual customers and their contact information for Northwind trading operations.

columns.name: CustomerID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in customers

columns.name: CompanyName
columns.description: Stores names of customer companies.

columns.name: ContactName
columns.description: Stores names of primary contacts for each customer in Northwind database.

columns.name: ContactTitle
columns.description: Stores job titles of customer contacts, such as Sales Representative, Owner, Order Administrator.

columns.name: Address
columns.description: Stores street addresses for customers in various formats.

columns.name: City
columns.description: Stores city names for customers, as demonstrated by examples like Berlin, México D.F., London, and Luleå.

columns.name: Region
columns.description: Stores customer locations as two-letter abbreviations for Canadian (BC) and Spanish-speaking (SP) provinces/regions, or Oregon (OR).

columns.name: PostalCode
columns.description: Stores alphanumeric postal codes up to 10 characters, including international formats.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores customer countries as text up to 50 characters long, including Germany, Mexico, UK, and Sweden.

columns.name: Phone
columns.description: Stores customer phone numbers in various formats, including area code and local number.

columns.name: Fax
columns.description: Stores customer fax numbers as international or domestic phone numbers in various formats.

employees._description: Captures information about individual employees within the Northwind organization.

columns.name: EmployeeID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in employees

columns.name: LastName
columns.description: Stores surnames of up to 10 characters for Northwind employees.

columns.name: FirstName
columns.description: Stores up to 10 characters of employees' first names.

columns.name: Title
columns.description: Stores job titles for employees within Northwind, such as Sales Representative, Vice President, Sales Manager, etc.

columns.name: TitleOfCourtesy
columns.description: Stores formal titles of courtesy for employees (e.g., Ms., Dr., Mrs., Mr.).

columns.name: BirthDate
columns.description: Stores employee birthdates in a format of month/day/year (MM/DD/YYYY).

columns.name: HireDate
columns.description: Stores employee hire dates in a format of month/day/year.

columns.name: Address
columns.description: Stores street addresses for employees, including apartment numbers and city names.

columns.name: City
columns.description: Stores employee location cities (Seattle, Tacoma, Kirkland, Redmond, London).

columns.name: Region
columns.description: Stores the state region for employees (e.g., WA).

columns.name: PostalCode
columns.description: Stores alphanumeric postal codes up to 10 characters, including international formats.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores employee's nationality (USA or UK).

columns.name: HomePhone
columns.description: Stores employee home phone numbers in North American format.

columns.name: Extension
columns.description: Stores unique four-digit extension numbers for employees.

columns.name: Photo
columns.description: The employees table's Photo column stores employee images (as text), but no sample values are provided.

columns.name: Notes
columns.description: Stores personal educational backgrounds of employees.
samples: Education includes a BA in psychology from Colorado State University in 1970.  She also completed "The Art of the Cold Call."  Nancy is a member of Toastmasters International.

Andrew received his BTS commercial in 1974 and a Ph.D. in international marketing from the University of Dallas in 1981.  He is fluent in French and Italian and reads German.  He joined the company as a sales representative, was promoted to sales manager in January 1992 and to vice president of sales in March 1993.  Andrew is a member of the Sales Management Roundtable, the Seattle Chamber of Commerce, and the Pacific Rim Importers Association.

Janet has a BS degree in chemistry from Boston College (1984).  She has also completed a certificate program in food retailing management.  Janet was hired as a sales associate in 1991 and promoted to sales representative in February 1992.

Margaret holds a BA in English literature from Concordia College (1958) and an MA from the American Institute of Culinary Arts (1966).  She was assigned to the London office temporarily from July through November 1992.

Steven Buchanan graduated from St. Andrews University, Scotland, with a BSC degree in 1976.  Upon joining the company as a sales representative in 1992, he spent 6 months in an orientation program at the Seattle office and then returned to his permanent post in London.  He was promoted to sales manager in March 1993.  Mr. Buchanan has completed the courses "Successful Telemarketing" and "International Sales Management."  He is fluent in French.

columns.name: ReportsTo
columns.description: Employee ID of immediate supervisor.

columns.name: PhotoPath
columns.description: Stores URL paths for employee profile pictures.

shippers._description: Tracks information about various shipping companies used by Northwind Traders for order delivery.

columns.name: ShipperID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in shippers

columns.name: CompanyName
columns.description: Stores names of shipping companies such as Speedy Express, United Package, and Federal Shipping.

columns.name: Phone
columns.description: Stores phone numbers for shippers, formatted as area code followed by seven digits.

suppliers._description: Tracks information about various suppliers and their details in Northwind's supply chain.

columns.name: SupplierID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in suppliers

columns.name: CompanyName
columns.description: Stores names of suppliers, ranging from food providers like Exotic Liquids to cheese cooperatives such as Las Cabras.

columns.name: ContactName
columns.description: Stores names of primary contacts for each supplier.

columns.name: ContactTitle
columns.description: Stores job titles of contacts for suppliers.

columns.name: Address
columns.description: Stores street addresses, postal boxes, roads, and city names for suppliers.

columns.name: City
columns.description: Stores city names for suppliers.

columns.name: Region
columns.description: Stores geographical regions for suppliers, represented by abbreviations such as LA, MI, Asturias, Victoria, OR.

columns.name: PostalCode
columns.description: Stores up to 10 alphanumeric characters representing postal codes for suppliers.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores the country of origin for suppliers.

columns.name: Phone
columns.description: Stores international phone numbers in various formats.

columns.name: Fax
columns.description: Stores international fax numbers up to 50 characters long.

columns.name: HomePage
columns.description: Stores URLs or HTML file names for suppliers' websites.
